description: A shell project for the container tier: prints a line and the user id, writes one JUnit result file, and exits with status 3.

entries.content:
echo 'hello from the sandbox'
id -u
mkdir -p reports
printf '%s' '<testsuites><testsuite name="sample"><testcase classname="sample" name="passes"/></testsuite></testsuites>' > reports/junit.xml
exit 3
